## Self-check

1. **No.** Same IoC idea; Boot starts and configures it for you.
2. Your freedom to **override** Boot defaults by defining your own bean first.
3. **False.** Tomcat shows up when web-related dependencies/auto-config apply (typically `spring-boot-starter-web`).
4. In the **root application package**, so scanning picks up all sub-packages.
